title: Environment structure and base installation
summary: A venv configuration references its base installation and has a local interpreter entry. Missing configuration, base installation, broken interpreter symlink or version-contract mismatch can invalidate declared structure.
checks: Check the declared venv root, cfg version and approved base/interpreter paths.
Recreate an environment from controlled dependency inputs after operator review if its base or structure is invalid.
limitations: Static structure does not verify interpreter execution, ABI, shared libraries or imports.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
